description: On-device Vietnamese/English TTS (48 kHz) with instant voice cloning from 3-5 s of reference audio, by Phạm Nguyễn Ngọc Bảo (pnnbao97). Takes SEA-G2P phonemes as text input.

request.name: auto_frame_cap
request.description: Cap the generation budget using the chunk's phoneme count. Legacy frame_cap remains accepted.

request.name: text_chunk_min_size
request.description: Phoneme-string chunks shorter than this character count join a neighbour. Legacy text_chunk_min remains accepted.

request.name: speaker_embedding_file
request.description: File containing a comma-separated 192-dimensional speaker embedding.

request.name: speaker_embedding
request.description: Inline comma-separated 192-dimensional speaker embedding.

request.name: reference_codes
request.description: Pre-encoded reference codes in row-major order, comma- or space-separated; codebooks per frame come from the checkpoint.

request.name: reference_codes_file
request.description: Pre-encoded reference codes, one frame per line. Replaces audio encoding and can be used with a speaker embedding instead of reference audio.

request.name: x_vector_only_mode
request.description: Clone using only the speaker embedding. Defaults to true for embedding-only input, otherwise false.

request.name: encode_reference_only
request.description: Encode reference audio and return an acoustic-tokens artifact without generating speech.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated frames per text chunk; uses the checkpoint max_new_tokens setting (300 fallback). Each frame represents 80 ms.

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Enable sampling for all codebooks unless subtalker_do_sample overrides later codebooks.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Sampling temperature for all codebooks unless overridden for the subtalker.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Top-k sampling limit for all codebooks unless overridden for the subtalker.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Nucleus cutoff within top-k candidates, unless overridden for the subtalker.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Repetition penalty applied independently to each codebook.

request.name: repetition_window
request.description: Recent frames remembered per codebook for repetition penalties; zero uses all history.

request.name: babble_retries
request.description: Regenerations for short chunks that exceed their text; zero disables the guard.

request.name: subtalker_temperature
request.description: Temperature override for later codebooks; omitted or negative inherits temperature.

request.name: subtalker_top_k
request.description: Top-k override for later codebooks; omitted or negative inherits top_k.

request.name: subtalker_top_p
request.description: Nucleus cutoff override for later codebooks; omitted or negative inherits top_p.

request.name: subtalker_do_sample
request.description: Sampling override for later codebooks; inherits do_sample when omitted.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampling seed; omitted draws a random seed.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum character budget per phoneme-string chunk; must be positive.

session.name: g2p_dict_file
session.description: SEA-G2P dictionary file (sea_g2p.bin). When set, input is Vietnamese/English text rather than precomputed phonemes.

session.name: g2p_library
session.description: SEA-G2P shared library used with g2p_dict_file; searched by library name when omitted.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release the talker cached-step graph after each request.

session.name: voice_prompt_cache_slots
session.description: Prepared voice-prompt cache slots; zero disables caching.

session.name: talker_weight_type
session.description: Talker matmul storage; inherits weight_type when omitted.

session.name: talker_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Talker graph metadata arena. Size in MiB; must be positive.

session.name: speech_decoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec decoder graph metadata arena. Size in MiB; must be positive.

session.name: speaker_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Speaker encoder graph metadata arena. Size in MiB; must be positive.

session.name: talker_constant_context_mb
session.description: Talker constant metadata context. Size in MiB; must be positive.

session.name: code_predictor_constant_context_mb
session.description: Code predictor constant metadata context. Size in MiB; must be positive.

session.name: speech_decoder_constant_context_mb
session.description: Codec decoder constant metadata context. Size in MiB; must be positive.

packages.display_name: VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo Q8_0 GGUF (first community port, July 2026 weights)
